content.comment_body: Hello everyone, How can analog input scaling be done in [product_name]? Are there any available function blocks for this purpose?

You can use the analog amplifier block for this. It is available as a separate function block and is also integrated into certain other analog blocks, like the analog threshold switch. To learn more, insert the relevant analog block, right-click, and select Help from the menu. [url]
I need to scale a 4-20 mA input, but I am unable to set the maximum engineering value to 27648.

The value you mentioned (27648) applies to the [product_name] family of [company_name] PLCs, not to [product_name]. [product_name] is different and shouldn't be directly compared to [product_name] PLCs.

[product_name] converts every analog signal to a 0-1000 scale, whether it is 0/4-20 mA, 0/2-10V, or a PT100/1000. The analog amplifier block allows you to adjust this 0-1000 scale to match your input requirements. For example, if you have a pressure sensor (0-10 bar, 4-20 mA): Sensor type: 4-20 mA; Minimum: 0; Maximum: 1000; Gain: 1.25; Offset: -250; Decimal places in the message text: 2. This results in a display range from 0.00 to 10.00 bar.
This approach is the best way to handle scaling as outlined in the previous message.
